title: Plan
description: Planner-internal rich plan schema produced by ai-code-planner. This is NOT the format ai-code-worker consumes — worker consumes the projected subset described in docs/LINTER-CONTRACT.md. Information loss at projection time is reported by the linter.

nonGoals.description: Explicit list of what this plan does not address.

ambiguities.description: Open questions or ambiguities that were not resolved before planning.

risk.description: Overall risk level of this plan.

planningProvenance.description: Who planned this, with what topology, how many rounds, and at what cost. This field will be tightened to a $ref to ./planning-provenance.schema.json once schemas/planning-provenance.schema.json exists in the same directory.

tasks.description: Ordered list of tasks in the plan DAG.

Task.description: A single task in the plan DAG.

id.description: Stable, unique task identifier within this plan and the worker manifest. It starts with an uppercase letter or digit and uses only uppercase letters, digits, dot, underscore, or hyphen.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Structured acceptance criteria. Each entry has a stable criterionId and human-readable text — not bare strings.

gates.description: Verification gates that must pass before this task is considered complete.

command.description: The command or check to run.

evidenceContract.description: Human-readable description of what constitutes passing evidence for this gate.

dependsOn.description: IDs of tasks that must complete before this task can start.

allowedPaths.description: Paths this task may read or write.

forbiddenPaths.description: Paths this task must not touch.

requiredInputs.description: Typed pointers to inputs this task depends on. Pointers are frozen; content is resolved at execution time. Not bare path strings — each entry carries a kind discriminant.

ref.description: The pointer reference: file path, fully-qualified symbol name, or external URL/identifier.

executionProfile.description: Logical execution profile name from ADR-0001 (e.g. 'backend-balanced-v1') that advises model and capability selection for this task.

relevantSymbols.description: Fully-qualified symbols relevant to this task, used for context loading.
